fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE rule blocking values >124 in core network.
Enable 5G NAS integrity protection for all NAS messages.
Enforce NAS security mode command (SMC) validation per 3GPP TS 24.501.
Set RAN timer T350 (NAS inactivity) to 30 seconds for suspicious IMSIs.
Implement NAS message replay attack detection with sequence number checks.
Configure core to reject NAS messages without valid NAS security context.
Deploy NAS-based IMSI blacklisting for known rogue base station IMSIs.
Enable 5G NAS message logging for forensic analysis of suspicious traces.
Set NAS message rate limit (e.g., 5 messages/minute per UE).
Trigger automated RAN isolation for UEs with repeated NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE=125.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
